title: A Day Out Loud
logline: One person, one Thursday, four places to type, zero typing. Kinetic type carries the story; the only voice is hers, talking to her Mac.
treatments_note: The brief mentioned two director treatments but only one arrived. It is used as the spine, with producer corrections listed in STORYBOARD.md.

output.codec: H.264 High, yuv420p, BT.709 tagged, CRF 14, AAC 256 kb/s 48 kHz stereo
output.render: Playwright page with a paused clock advanced one frame per tick; camera keys {t, s, cx, cy} in world units, clamped so the view never leaves the world

wallpaper.source: Tools/VibeScribeScreenshots/main.swift Wallpaper (copy the recipe, do not import the file)

fonts.ui: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui (Chromium on macOS resolves this to SF Pro; never bundle or commit SF font files)
fonts.mono: 'SF Mono' loaded via @font-face from /System/Applications/Utilities/Terminal.app/Contents/Resources/Fonts/SF-Mono-{Regular,Medium,Semibold,Bold}.otf at render time (local file URL, not copied into the repo)
fonts.numerals: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for every timer and count

hero_xl.enter: slam: scale 1.18->1.0 over 0.18 s easeOutBack, opacity 0->1 over 0.08 s

hero.enter: rise 18 px + opacity over 0.28 s easeOutCubic, per word stagger 0.06 s

caption.scrim: bottom 220 px gradient rgba(0,0,0,0)->rgba(0,0,0,0.35) while any caption is up
caption.enter: per word: rise 10 px + opacity over 0.22 s, stagger 0.05 s
caption.exit: opacity + 6 px drift up over 0.2 s

sub.enter: opacity over 0.3 s, 0.12 s after its headline

keycap_inline.note: inline mini keycap inside a caption: fill #34343A, radius 6, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.14) border, 0.8 em glyph

spectrum_rule.note: 7 equal segments in theme.spectrum order, height 6 px, radius 3, drawn left to right over 0.3 s

styles_note: Sizes are in world/screen units (1440x810 frame). Output pixels = units x 4/3. 'screen' text ignores the camera; 'world' elements move with it. Title-safe margin 72 units.

menubar.text: 13 pt medium white; app name 13 pt bold
menubar.layout: matches StoreMenuBar in Tools/VibeScribeScreenshots/AppStoreShots.swift: padding 18 each side; apple.logo 14 pt then 21 gap; app name then 19 gap; each menu then 19 gap; spacer; VibeScribe status item then 14 gap; wifi glyph then 16 gap; battery.75percent then 16 gap; clock text (24-hour, like History)

status_item.idle: SF Symbol waveform (template, white) + ' ' + language badge (EN / DE / AUTO), NSFont.monospacedDigitSystemFont 11 pt semibold
status_item.recording: StatusIcons.bars: 7 bars in theme.spectrum, barWidth 2.2, gap 1.6, height 15; wobble = 0.72 + 0.28*sin(t*(7+i) + i*1.3); fraction = clamp(0.22 + 0.78*level*profile[i]*wobble, 0.2, 1). Title = Format.duration(t - started_at) which ROUNDS (so it reads 0:01 after 0.5 s). Redraw at 12 fps. No highlight capsule (the real status item is not highlighted).
status_item.transcribing: StatusIcons.thinking: white template bars, fraction 0.25 + 0.55*max(0, sin(4.4t - 0.55i)); title back to the language badge

pill.geometry: height 34, radius 12 continuous, padding leading 13 trailing 14, HStack spacing 10, title 12 pt semibold white, meta 11.5 pt mono white 55%

placement_world.note: overlay panel 620x64 sits 10 pt below the visible top (menu bar 26) with 6 pt top padding, so the pill top is 16 pt below the menu bar

pill.enter: spring(response 0.38, dampingFraction 0.78): scale 0.8 -> 1 anchored top, opacity 0 -> 1, y -12 -> 0
pill.exit: opacity 1 -> 0, y 0 -> -8 on the same spring
pill.state_change: title crossfades (contentTransition .opacity); width springs between sprite widths (crossfade both sprites over 0.22 s while scaling X from old width to new width about the centre)

region_pt.note: 7 bars, barWidth 3, spacing 2, vertically centred; drawn by the stage on top of the clean-plated sprite

bars.live: fraction = clamp(0.2 + 0.03*sin(3t + phase[i]) + 0.8*level*profile[i]*(0.72 + 0.28*sin(t*speed[i] + phase[i])), 0.18, 1); bar height = max(barWidth, 16*fraction); refresh at 30 fps (TimelineView minimumInterval 1/30), hold between refreshes

pill.level: per 1024-sample window at 48 kHz (21.3 ms) of the dry voice: target = clamp((20*log10(rms) + 50)/40, 0, 1); level += (target - level) * (target > level ? 0.6 : 0.15). Silence before the voice gives level ~0.
pill.timer: Listening/Hands-free meta = Format.duration of whole seconds since started_at, advancing only at started_at + n (TimelineView .periodic by 1), i.e. floor. Starts at 0:00.
pill.shimmer: Transcribing only: band of white 10% (clear-white-clear gradient), width 50% of pill, x offset = width*(1.5*p - 0.5), p = (t mod 1.6)/1.6, clipped to the pill shape
pill.durations: Pasted shows 1.3 s then exits; Copied would show 2.2 s (not used)

picker.enter: from top = -358 (panel bottom 12 pt above the visible top) to 106, alpha 0 -> 1, 0.18 s easeOut

keycap_hud.what: Film device, not app UI: shows which key the person presses. Uses the real Keycap view sprites (fill #34343A).
keycap_hud.press: keycap translates down 2 units and its top face brightens 12% while held; release springs back over 0.12 s
keycap_hud.enter_exit: fade + 8 unit rise over 0.15 s; leaves 0.4 s after the last release
keycap_hud.tap_label: for taps, a small 'tap' label (sub style, 15 units) under the keycap

stage.pointer: generic macOS arrow cursor drawn as an SVG by the stage, 18 units tall, with a soft shadow

camera_eases.whip: easeInOutExpo with 6-frame directional motion blur along the move

timing_rules.hold_loop: key_down = voice_start - 0.30; recording_start = key_down + 0.05; key_up = voice_end + 0.20; stop/Transcribing = key_up + 0.20; Pasted = stop + transcribing_hold; hidden = Pasted + 1.3
timing_rules.tap_loop: tap1_down = voice_start - 0.50 (held 0.15 s); recording_start = tap1_down + 0.05; Hands-free at tap1_up; tap2_down = voice_end + 0.25 (held 0.12 s); stop = tap2_up + 0.20

transcribing_hold_s.why: never imply instant transcription; large-v3 takes a moment

timing_rules.timelines: overlay, menubar_status and keycap_hud entries are evaluated on the global clock; an entry may land after its scene's end (E's pill exit at 42.52 is repeated in F for clarity)
timing_rules.history_duration: recordedDuration = stop - recording_start; shown with Format.duration (rounded)
timing_rules.retime: Start times are targets. After synthesis, re-anchor every voice-driven event to the measured clip using the formulas above, push later events in the same scene by the delta, then shift following scenes so transitions keep their cover points. If the film runs past 60.0 s, trim holds in this order: B establishing (4.35-5.2), the F 'Nothing leaves it.' hold, the H tail. Keep montage cards at 1.6 s. Regenerate the music to the final section times.

sfx_note: All sounds are original and synthesised or recorded for this film. 'app_analogue' cues stand in for the system Tink/Pop the app plays when Play sounds is on (default).

music.source: original, generated procedurally in Node at build time (no samples from commercial libraries, no Apple sounds)
music.feel: half-time (backbeat on beat 3), one bar = 1.6 s, phrase boundaries quantised to 0.8 s
music.mood: warm, optimistic, light; soft plucks, rounded sub bass, airy pad, brushed hats; never busy under the voice
palette: sine/triangle pluck with short decay and stereo delay 3/16
detuned saw pad through a low-pass at 1.8 kHz
synth kick (55 Hz), rim click, noise hats

sections.content: impact on 'Free', kick on 1 only, pluck arpeggio, riser ticks into the menu bar at 3.6
minimal groove: kick + rim, quiet pluck; voice duck
adds closed hats and a pluck counter-line
adds moving bass; small lift on the picker
evening colour: filter closes a little, hats thin out
drums out on the whip; pad + sub hold D then Bm; space for the privacy lines
full groove, chord stabs on each card boundary
contract on 53.6, final D major chord with bell at 54.0, ring out; fade 57.4-58.4

music.transition_note: Cover points at 15.6 and 25.6 sit up to 0.4 s off a section start; the transition whoosh bridges the gap.
music.ducking: sidechain from the voice bus: -8 dB, attack 30 ms, release 250 ms; also -3 dB under each app-analogue start/stop sound
music.master: two-pass loudnorm to -16 LUFS integrated, -1.5 dBTP, LRA 11; AAC 256 kb/s, 48 kHz stereo

preview_cut.render: natively at 30 fps from the same stage (not decimated from the 60 fps master)
preview_cut.codec: H.264 High, yuv420p, BT.709, 30 fps constant, AAC 256 kb/s 48 kHz stereo; ProRes 422 HQ mezzanine optional

segments.notes: Opens straight on the compose window (no cold open, no 'Free'). Camera at src 5.2 is already settled at s 1.15.
The film caption 'Talk to your coding agent.' is replaced by 'Transcribed on your Mac.'
Ends on the sent German bubble (src 33.9); Lena's reply is cut. Film captions in D are replaced.

elements.text: Hold a key. Speak. It's pasted.

segments.notes: No price words, no 'App Store', no URL. The pill's '6 words' counts the line above it.

preview_cut.poster_note: the 'Pasted 19 words' moment with the reply in the compose window
preview_cut.sfx: same cues as the film, shifted by (dst_in - src_in) per segment; drop cues that fall outside a segment; add one bloom at the slate
preview_cut.music: separate procedural render of exactly total_s: verse groove from 0 (no 'Free' impact), lift at P3, resolve to D major with the bell on the slate at 26.9 s; same ducking and master
preview_cut.film_transitions: off: only the preview transition_out entries are drawn; film captions are replaced by each segment's captions; keycap HUD, pill, menu bar and camera follow the film timeline at src time
rules: primarily app footage; text overlays are captions only
no pricing words anywhere: no 'free', 'subscription', price, 'App Store'
15 to 30 s; we cap at 29.5 s
